concerns.text: SC-002 requires measuring the reduction in dynamic‑execution cycles (percentage of tasks skipped). No task in tasks.md creates, computes, or validates this metric, leaving the success criterion untestable.

SC-004 mandates measuring computational feasibility (runtime ≤6 h, memory ≤7 GB). While profiling tasks T035a‑c generate logs, there is no test or verification step that asserts the pipeline stays within the GitHub Actions limits, so this success criterion lacks coverage.
